schema.title: The Official Guide to the Kanban Method (v2.1)
schema.description: A kanban system, as the Kanban Guide and its glossary define it.

ChangeManagementPrinciple.description: These Change Management Principles are common to all Kanban implementations.
enum: Start with what you do now
Agree to pursue improvement through evolutionary change
Encourage acts of leadership at all levels
Understand and focus on customer needs and expectations
Manage the work; let people self-organize around it
Regularly review the network of services and its policies in order to improve outcomes

GeneralPractice.description: The six general practices of the Kanban Method.

WipLimit.description: A policy that constrains the amount of work allowed in a given part of the kanban system. It can be set per workflow state, per person, per lane, per work type or for the whole system.

scope.description: The part of the kanban system the limit constrains.

limit.description: The maximum number of work items allowed at one time.

Board.description: A visual display of cards that represent the work items in a kanban system. Every board shows at least one clear commitment point and delivery point, and how much work in progress is permitted.

policies.description: Agreements on how the service delivery will be handled.

metrics.description: Metrics are a means of feedback to indicate how a system is performing.

cadences.description: The regular meetings and reviews that put Kanban's feedback loops into practice.
